_about: Witchy Flap - Halloween flappy game asset pack (fine pixel art, storybook palette). Generated by /workspace/halloween-game/tools/pack/build_all.py (SVG -> 4x supersample -> box downsample -> palette quantize + Bayer dither -> selective outline).
recommended_render: Render the game at native 180x320 on a canvas, then scale x3 (540x960) with ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false; CSS image-rendering: pixelated.

font.pixel_sizes: use 8, 16, 24 px (multiples of 8) for crisp text

character.frame_order: left->right in a horizontal strip, frame i at x=i*141
character.anchor_note: Every layer uses the SAME 141x96 canvas; draw all chosen layers at the same (x,y) with the same frame index. Anchor = canvas centre of the rider.

hitbox_suggestion.note: relative to canvas top-left; forgiving body hitbox (ignore broom ends)

character.hair_rule: hair_back and hair_front must use the same style name (e.g. long_wavy + long_wavy). Names with a colour suffix (_black,_blonde,_brown,_white,_teal) are pre-coloured; plain names are ginger AND have a _tint version.
character.species_rule: species = head layer. witch_<skin> = human witch with 8 skin tones (incl. green, blue, lavender). zombie, vampire, skeleton, werewolf, mummy, pumpkin_head, ghost are full alternative heads+hands, compatible with every outfit/mount/hat. Suggest hiding hair for skeleton/mummy/pumpkin_head/ghost/werewolf (looks better without).

tint.method: Runtime recolor (canvas 2D): on an offscreen canvas of frame size: 1) drawImage(tintPNG); 2) ctx.globalCompositeOperation="multiply"; fillStyle=chosenColor; fillRect(...); 3) ctx.globalCompositeOperation="destination-in"; drawImage(tintPNG) (restores transparency); 4) reset to "source-over" and draw the offscreen canvas as the layer. Cache the result per (layer,color). Bright colors work best (HSV value >= 70%); the dark selective outline stays dark automatically.
tint.note: Tint versions recolor the whole layer (small details like belts/buttons become the same hue). Use the coloured file when the default look is wanted.

character.combinatorics: 2499840 combinations with preset colours only (mount x outfit x head x hat+none x hair+none x front accessory+none x cape+none); with runtime HSV tint on outfit/hat/hair/cape it is effectively unlimited.

small_variant.note: SAME layers/names/frames/order rendered at ~58% size for IN-GAME use on the 180x320 screen (figure ~52px tall). Use character.* (141x96, figure ~85px) for menus, shop, wardrobe preview. Paths: native/character_small/{slot}/{name}.png, tint files too.

shop_suggestions._note: SUGGESTIONS ONLY for CODE - balance freely. Prices in candy coins.

mount.bone.perk: first crash into the ground is forgiven (bounce)

outfit.pumpkin_suit.perk: obstacles slow down 3s after each 10 points

accessory.pet_bat.perk: pet bat eats 1 enemy bat per run

hat.crown.perk: start each run with a shield bubble

hair.*.perk: free; colours via tint (or 20 coins per colour if you want a sink)
